instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace all visible instances of brand name 'jeemains.ai' with 'JEELIVE.AI' across headers, footers, titles, and wordmarks.
2. Eliminate all teal color usage (#1B93A4 / bg-teal-*) from the dashboard cards.
3. Apply Deep Shining Blue theme to the flagship All India / JEE Main card with high-end sapphire glow and active shining sweep overlay.
4. Apply Premium Black (Obsidian & Platinum Luxury) theme to the COMEDK cards with subtle metallic borders.
5. Apply Premium Orange (Radiant Copper & Blaze) theme to the BITSAT cards with glowing amber edges.
6. Ensure all interactive buttons, card anchors, and tabs have proper data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='flagship-jee-card', data-testid='comedk-card', data-testid='bitsat-card').
7. Retain all existing streak journey logic, running athlete animations, trophy celebrations, timers, and 62-day rules without breaking functionality.
8. Maintain clean light/dark toggle accessibility and mobile responsive layouts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts and cheap gradients. Use crisp borders, layered z-indices, and optical alignment.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use transition: all. Use targeted CSS properties like transition-transform or transition-colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or cards where content scrolls underneath; use backdrop-blur and glassmorphism styling.
